description: Source code defining classes and functions related to Xcode project object representations, including PBX objects, build phases, targets, and project structure. Contains implementation details for encoding strings, managing PBX object references, and printing project components.

classes.name: PBXObject
classes.description: Base class for all PBX project objects, providing reference handling and visitor pattern support.

classes.name: PBXTarget
classes.description: Represents a build target in an Xcode project, including dependencies, build phases, and configuration list.

classes.name: PBXProject
classes.description: Represents an entire Xcode project, managing targets, configurations, and project structure.

classes.name: XCConfigurationList
classes.description: Holds a list of build configurations for a project or target.

classes.name: PBXBuildPhase
classes.description: Abstract class for build phases, managing build files.

classes.name: PBXFileReference
classes.description: Represents a file or resource in the project, with type and path information.

classes.name: PBXGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of files or other groups, forming the project hierarchy.

classes.name: PBXNativeTarget
classes.description: Represents a native build target with specific build phases and product references.

classes.name: PBXAggregateTarget
classes.description: Represents an aggregate target, a collection of build targets.

classes.name: PBXBuildFile
classes.description: Associates a file reference with a build phase.

classes.name: PBXContainerItemProxy
classes.description: Proxy object linking targets and projects.

classes.name: XCBuildConfiguration
classes.description: Represents a build configuration with settings.

methods.name: EncodeString
methods.description: Encodes a string with escape sequences for special characters.

methods.name: GetSourceType
methods.description: Returns the source type string based on file extension.

methods.name: FindFilenameOffset
methods.description: Finds the offset of filename without extension.

methods.name: FindExtensionOffset
methods.description: Finds the offset of file extension in filename.
